name: PLATO MINLP Benchmark
description: Benchmarks mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) solvers on 200 nontrivial instances from MINLPLIB, requiring proof of global optimality within a 2-hour time limit. MINLP combines the combinatorial difficulty of integer programming with the non-convexity of nonlinear programming, making it among the hardest problem classes in mathematical optimisation. Solvers include BARON, Gurobi, LINDO, SCIP, SHOT, and XPRESS.
domain: optimization, mixed-integer nonlinear programming, operations research
typical_sota_score: BARON solves 158/200 (82.5s unscaled mean, 1.0 scaled mean). Other solvers: 96–158 instances solved. 2-hour time limit.
reputation: The primary MINLP solver benchmark; maintained by Hans Mittelmann and widely cited in computational OR and chemical engineering.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Gurobi and XPRESS results publication-suppressed. Hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X (12 cores, 128GB). Instances from MINLPLIB.
